description: Token savings and latency benchmarks for scripts/bulk-read. Case shapes adapted from spotify/portal-ai-plugins' shunt benchmarks (single large file, source+test pair, multi-file cross-read); fixture content is original, generated by evals/fixtures/generate.sh.

benchmarks.name: single-large-file
benchmarks.description: Read one large file and summarize its exports
benchmarks.question: What are all the exported classes and methods in this file, and what does each method do?

benchmarks.name: source-plus-test
benchmarks.description: Read a source file and its test file to understand coverage
benchmarks.question: What methods does TaskQueue have, and which of them are covered by the tests in the second file?

benchmarks.name: multi-file-cross-read
benchmarks.description: Read three unrelated files and answer a cross-cutting question
benchmarks.question: Which classes are exported across these files, and roughly how many methods does each one have?
